tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Identity and primary actions (indigo): filled buttons, links, the selected tab, the focused series. As text 6.0:1 on bg and 6.5:1 on surface (light), 6.4:1 and 5.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand text: the selected nav row, brand chips. brand on brand-bg is 5.5:1 (light) and 4.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark text in the dark theme because the lightened indigo needs it: 6.5:1 (light), 6.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational actions and marks (sky). Decorative in light: 3.2:1 on bg, so icons and 24px+ text only; small text uses status-info.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind informational text.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text on an info fill. White on light info is only 3.5:1: bold 19px+ labels only.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Settled, or owed to you (mint). Decorative in light (3.3:1 on bg): marks, bars and 24px+ amounts; small text uses status-positive.

tokens.name: positive-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind settled / owed-to-you text.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: You owe, or needs attention (coral). Decorative in light (3.6:1 on bg): marks, bars and 24px+ amounts; small text uses status-negative.

tokens.name: negative-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind you-owe text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution marks. Decorative in light (3.1:1 on bg); small text uses status-warning.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind caution text.

tokens.name: status-positive
tokens.usage: Readable settled / owed-to-you text and amounts on bg, surface and positive-bg (light 5.2/5.6/5.0:1).

tokens.name: status-negative
tokens.usage: Readable you-owe text and amounts on bg, surface and negative-bg (light 5.3/5.8/5.0:1).

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Readable caution text on bg, surface and warning-bg (light 5.8/6.4/5.8:1).

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Readable informational text on bg, surface and info-bg (light 5.2/5.7/5.1:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised chrome: the web sidebar and top bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside a card: table headers, empty states, the Month bar track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and navigation items on elevated surfaces.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines. Decorative (1.2–1.5:1): never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised dividers and input outlines at rest.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-muted (16:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on any surface (6.9:1 and up).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints and timestamps. On surface 4.8:1 (light); on bg it is 4.39:1 and on surface-muted 4.2:1, so use it there only at 19px bold or 24px+. Dark 4.5:1 and up everywhere.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on the inverse surface and on dark fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: a solid 2px ring 2px outside the control, 5.7:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The soft 4px halo drawn with the focus outline. Decorative; the solid outline carries the meaning.

tokens.name: strip-start
tokens.usage: Boarding-pass trip strip: first gradient stop (135deg). The strip is the one signature element; use it only for a Trip's header.

tokens.name: strip-mid
tokens.usage: Trip strip: middle stop at 55%.

tokens.name: strip-end
tokens.usage: Trip strip: last stop.

tokens.name: strip-text
tokens.usage: Text on the trip strip (6.5:1 at its lightest stop in light, 7.7:1 in dark).

tokens.name: strip-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the trip strip: dates, Trip day labels.

tokens.name: strip-perforation
tokens.usage: The punched holes along the strip's stub seam: the page colour showing through.

tokens.name: strip-stub
tokens.usage: The stub panel's lift on the right of the strip.

tokens.name: chart-series
tokens.usage: The one series colour in a chart: the figure in focus, such as the current Month.

tokens.name: chart-series-soft
tokens.usage: The series hue for columns not in focus; still 3:1 against a card.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: diverging-positive
tokens.usage: Owed-to-you bars in a diverging chart (Balances' Everyone). The sign is the figure; bars still carry their amount as text.

tokens.name: diverging-negative
tokens.usage: Owes bars in a diverging chart.

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Inverse surface: chart tooltips and snackbars.

tokens.name: inverse-text
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-bg.

tokens.name: logo-indigo
tokens.usage: Logo artwork only (brand.json): the mark and wordmark on white or paper. Not a UI colour; UI indigo is brand.

tokens.name: logo-indigo-on-dark
tokens.usage: Logo artwork on ink or dark surfaces.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Single-colour logo ink and the primary app icon's ground (white mark on ink).

tokens.name: logo-paper
tokens.usage: Paper behind light logo lockups and the light splash.

groups.name: UI
groups.note: Outfit (Google Fonts, weights 400–700) for every word. MUI's type scale at a 16px root, with the app's overrides on h5, h6, subtitles, button and overline.

styles.name: subtitle1
styles.usage: Row titles: an Expense's description, a member's name.

styles.name: subtitle2
styles.usage: Labels above values and compact row titles.

styles.name: body1
styles.sample: Everyone in the Group sees what changed and who changed it.

styles.name: body2
styles.usage: Secondary rows, helper text and table cells.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Trip day and section eyebrows (MUI uppercases it).

groups.name: Money
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts, 400–600) for every amount, with tabular figures, so columns align and digits never shift width.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Every amount. It inherits the size of the line it sits in; this sample is at body1.

styles.name: money-large
styles.usage: A headline balance at h5 size, in status-positive or status-negative.

spacing.note: MUI's 8px scale: theme.spacing(n) = 8n px. Half steps exist where the app uses them.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Between rows in a dense list.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; Stack spacing between fields; the phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large section breaks on wide pages.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing-page section rhythm.

radius.note: Soft and consistent: RADIUS in design-tokens.ts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: the MUI theme's default shape.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and the trip strip.

shadow.note: Two quiet elevations; borders do most of the separating. Darker and wider in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and raised sheets.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The web app's full-height sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The web app's top bar.

tokens.name: content-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum content width inside the shell.
